tweets.text:
$118K+ WORTH OF FENTANYL SEIZED!
 
7/22-A Mexican national was apprehended transporting 16 pounds of fentanyl in a Nissan Sentra along Interstate 5 in San Clemente, CA. While conducting highway interdiction operations, USBP agents encountered the vehicle and conducted a K9 inspection. Seven packages of the dangerous drug were found in a backpack on the back seat. DEA seized the narcotics and took custody of the driver who now faces charges for possession of a controlled substance.
 
Since October, USBP and law enforcement partners have seized over 3,700 pounds of fentanyl with an estimated street value of $27.8 million. 💥
